start_here: Say to your AI: "Work out the span my booking's open times are read over." It runs tool:work-out-a-bookings-window, which answers from and to for tool:check-when-i-am-busy and changes nothing.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it works on the form_rows the pursuit database you name already holds, and a sitting is one row there.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the form rows, such as example_for_who_runs_it; the computer opens it with the login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:work-out-a-bookings-window and the input.
3. Give its answer, from and to, to tool:check-when-i-am-busy; that answer is the busy_read of the steps that work out open times.
